title: Repair Remote Desktop Commander autostart
description: Discover current RDC launch command, back up existing RDC scheduled tasks, create delayed per-user autostart task, start RDC immediately, verify process and task state. Do not delete unrelated application data.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$evidence=$root+'/rdc-autostart-repair-evidence.txt';'=== RDC AUTOSTART REPAIR ==='|Set-Content $evidence;('DATE='+(Get-Date -Format s))|Add-Content $evidence;$cmdLine=$null;$proc=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)'}|Select-Object -First 1;if($proc){$cmdLine=$proc.CommandLine;('SOURCE=running-process PID='+$proc.ProcessId)|Add-Content $evidence};$oldTasks=Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.TaskName -match '(?i)(desktop.?commander|remote.?desktop.?commander|3EN.?RDC|RDC)' -or (($_.Actions|Out-String) -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)')};if(-not $cmdLine){foreach($t in $oldTasks){foreach($a in $t.Actions){$candidate=(($a.Execute+' '+$a.Arguments).Trim());if($candidate -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)'){$cmdLine=$candidate;('SOURCE=scheduled-task '+$t.TaskName)|Add-Content $evidence;break}};if($cmdLine){break}}};if(-not $cmdLine){$npx=(Get-Command npx.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $npx){$npx=(Get-Command npx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source};if($npx){$cmdLine='"'+$npx+'" -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander';'SOURCE=npx-discovery'|Add-Content $evidence}};if(-not $cmdLine){throw 'RDC_LAUNCH_COMMAND_NOT_DISCOVERED'};('CMD='+$cmdLine)|Add-Content $evidence;foreach($t in $oldTasks){if($t.TaskName -ne '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart'){Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Out-Null;('DISABLED_OLD_TASK='+$t.TaskPath+$t.TaskName)|Add-Content $evidence}};$action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'cmd.exe' -Argument ('/d /c '+$cmdLine) -WorkingDirectory $env:USERPROFILE;$trigger=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User $env:USERNAME;$trigger.Delay='PT45S';$settings=New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Days 365);$principal=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited;Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Description '3EN035 Remote Desktop Commander delayed autostart; repaired 2026-09-11' -Force|Out-Null;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart';Start-Sleep 10;Write-Host 'RDC_AUTOSTART_REPAIR_EXECUTED'
